subject: English Home Language
theme: One or many, now or then

show.line: One cat, two cats. One box, two boxes. Add an ending for more than one. Jump, jumping, jumped!

rounds.prompt: One dog. Now there are more. Which word card says dogs?
One bus. Here are two. Say the word for more than one bus.
The girl is, gap, right now. Which word fits?
One wish, two what? Say the word.
Yesterday the boy, gap, his bike. Which word fits?
One, or more than one? Put each picture in its group.

hints: More than one? Add the sss sound at the end. Cats, dogs.
Happening now ends with ing. Already happened ends with ed.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! One fox. Here are two. I will say the word.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! More than one fox is foxes.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. One fox, two foxes!

parent_line: Can hear and use word endings for more than one, happening now and already happened.
